newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber slips, hopes for China deal dented.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber slips, hopes for China deal dented.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday on moderate profit-taking as players began to doubt market talk that China was looking to buy Thai rubber, Japanese traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 0.9 yen to 1.9 yen per kg lower. Benchmark November was down 1.0 at 137.7 yen. Volume was thin.

"Hopes that China will buy Thai rubber in the near future have been dented, and this undermined market sentiment," one trader said. There was talk that China may buy 80,000 tonnes of RSS3 rubber from Thailand in the second half of this year.
